review: Streaming UX is covered, but full-stack learners need semantic HTML, CSS layout, component state, forms, accessibility, and ordinary data-fetch behavior before realtime polish.
build: Build a responsive question form and task-history screen with explicit loading, empty, success, failed, and cancelled states. Add safe citation previews and a keyboard-accessible correction flow.
verify: Complete the journey with keyboard only and at a narrow viewport. A late response cannot overwrite a newer question, sign-out clears private cached state, and streamed tokens do not flood screen-reader announcements.
